scientific_integrity: All theorem assumptions and deterministic proof steps are stated; code is a finite diagnostic and does not independently certify infinite-time limits or scientific priority.
scientific_limitations: Assumes independent constant-speed excursions, instantaneous threshold resetting, stationary initialization, continuous positive cycle-duration law and finite third moment for the variance limit; time-dependent speed, noise, interactions, infinite-third-moment second moments and exact periodic clocks are not covered.
title: Universal boundary fluctuations and negative memory in ballistic threshold resetting
